tool-workspace.inventory_help: Paste probe results or select a JSON file up to 256 KiB. Files are read locally; registration sends only the selected profile.
tool-workspace.file_too_large: The file exceeds 256 KiB. Reduce the inventory and select it again. Your previous draft is retained.
tool-workspace.file_json_only: Select a .json inventory file. Your previous draft is retained.
tool-workspace.file_read_failed: Cannot read the file. Select it again or paste the inventory. Your previous draft is retained.
tool-workspace.name_help: The command name is suggested automatically. Choose a name your team can recognize.
tool-workspace.form_next.identity: Choose a currently authorized execution identity. If none is registered, return to the page to register a worker first.
tool-workspace.form_next.reading: Reading the file. Wait for it to finish or paste a newer inventory.
tool-workspace.form_next.inventory: Import or paste the non-secret inventory generated by the execution worker.
tool-workspace.form_next.invalid: Correct the inventory issues first. The current content cannot be registered.
tool-workspace.form_next.empty: The inventory has no configurations. Check the probe results.
tool-workspace.form_next.choose: Choose a configuration available at the probe. Resolve unavailable entries on the execution worker first.
tool-workspace.form_next.name: Enter a name for the selected configuration.
tool-workspace.form_next.ready: Ready to save. The configuration stays paused until explicitly reviewed and enabled for dispatch.
tool-workspace.form_next.expired: The adopted worker inventory has expired. Read and adopt a fresh report. Your name is retained.
tool-workspace.form_next.source_changed: The original read context has changed. Read and adopt the current worker report. Your name is retained.
tool-workspace.preflight.identity_ready: The current project's worker identity has been read. Saving and dispatch still check current authorization.
tool-workspace.preflight.inventory_live: The adopted report is within its original lifetime. Inventory freshness and machine credential expiry are checked separately.
tool-workspace.preflight.inventory_manua: The import format is valid. A manual inventory does not prove a worker is online, its credential is valid, or a model is authorized.
tool-workspace.preflight.configuration_r: A registrable configuration and name are selected. Saving keeps it paused; enabling needs a separate confirmation.
tool-workspace.receipt.registered: Configuration “{{name}}” registered and paused. Review it before explicitly enabling.
tool-workspace.receipt.enabled: Configuration “{{name}}” enabled. Actual dispatch still checks the current worker, permissions and probe results.
tool-workspace.receipt.paused: Configuration “{{name}}” paused and excluded from subsequent dispatch.
tool-workspace.receipt.revoked: Configuration “{{name}}” revoked. Historical records are retained.
tool-workspace.detail_unknown: The current read is unconfirmed. Refresh to check; retained information is reference only.
tool-workspace.detail_ready: Dispatch conditions were met at this read and will be checked again at dispatch. A probe does not establish model health or task completion.
tool-workspace.detail_paused: The configuration is registered and paused. Review the worker, version and permissions before explicitly enabling.
tool-workspace.detail_revoked: The configuration is permanently revoked and retained for history. Register a new configuration to use it again.
tool-workspace.help.identity: Create a project-scoped identity for a local or remote worker, then connect its installed tools.
tool-workspace.next.register: Import a probed inventory to register tools
tool-workspace.help.register: Paste the worker's non-secret inventory to validate and identify available configurations automatically. New registrations start paused.
tool-workspace.help.attention: Check the blocking reason, worker connection, configuration and latest probe before dispatching.
tool-workspace.help.review: Check the execution identity, pinned version and permissions, then explicitly enable. Actual dispatch checks them again.
tool-workspace.next.ready: Tools met dispatch conditions at this read
tool-workspace.help.ready: Return to a task to select a tool and preview its dispatch plan. Worker and permission checks run again at dispatch.
tool-workspace.help.refresh: A read is pending or the connection needs recovery. Retained configurations are reference only; refresh to check current conditions.
tool-workspace.import_result: Identified {{count}} configurations; {{available}} available at the local probe.
tool-workspace.query_invalid: The query is too long or contains control characters. Shorten it and try again.
tool-workspace.no_matches_hint: Adjust the search or state. Dispatch conditions filter only the currently loaded window.
tool-workspace.draft_retained: Public selections retained for node {{worker}}. Its report will be read again when you return.
tool-workspace.target_unavailable: The current catalogue has no unique connection entry for this tool protocol. Read it again; the original configuration is retained.
tool-workspace.remove_hint: This connection cannot be restored after removal. Historical runs and evidence are retained. This does not confirm existing external processes have stopped; check their original runs when needed.
tool-workspace.remove_confirm: Remove configuration v{{version}} and retain its history.
tool-workspace.shared_nodes: Shared nodes accessible to this project
tool-workspace.shared_nodes_hint: These are read-only identities currently authorized for this project. Contact the node manager for configuration or credential changes.
tool-workspace.shared_node_status: Reported identity status: {{status}}. Connection and dispatch conditions require separate checks.
